body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only.
- Basement solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type (run #17); **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED)**.
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip**; hidden-valley breach notches preserve this.
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: `level == 1` gates must become "topmost level" if more levels land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: HandoffTicksToImpact = 22.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (run #50)**: below view PLUMB, dim 0.06, hairlines, reveal.
- **Mesa model rejected**; stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic`, never the stale `def.graphic` field** (run-53; lore).
- **Settings IMGUI discipline**: deferred tab/expando switches, snapshot-gated rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.
- **Cross-level work migrates only for STRICTLY better-ranked work**; equal rank stays local (user-approved 2026-07-22). Async/actors/AOT rejected — main-thread sim only.
- **CrossLevelDemand skips Blueprint_Install** (fixed + verified run #62).
- **TEXTURE POLICY (2026-07-22, user-directed)**: user supplies ALL stair/ladder/elevator art. Stairs/grand/wide/ladders rotatable (Graphic_Multi); elevator NOT (Graphic_Single). Risers: vanilla/host-mod linked atlases on Conduits layer, no custom art.
- **Climb animations: vanilla pipeline only (2026-07-23, user-approved)**.

## BIOME-DRIVEN SKY PLATEAUS (2026-07-23, user request) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
Goal: sky generation matches the ground biome INCLUDING modded biomes (Ashlands, ReGrowth, More Vanilla Biomes, dense forests...). Audit result: flora seeding was ALREADY fully biome-driven (SeedPlateauFlora: ground biome AllWildPlants + CommonalityOfPlant + plantDensity — mod plants flow automatically), as are runtime regrowth/weather/wildlife via the inherited PrimaryBiome (pocketTileInfo swap in GenStep_ABSkyTerrain.Generate). The one hardcode: plateau ARABLE band = TerrainDefOf.Soil. Fix: `ArableTerrainFor(map.Biome)` — biome.terrainsByFertility at fertility 0.7; if that band's terrain fertility < 0.5, fall back to the biome's most fertile band; final fallback plain Soil (covers deserts + AB_OpenSky when inheritance off). Vanilla biomes resolve to Soil exactly as before (temperate: Soil band -999..0.87); modded biomes color their meadows natively. Mid band stays Gravel (universal weathered-top, plantable 0.7 fertility); rough band stays rock natural terrain; terrainPatchMakers deliberately NOT applied (ponds/marsh on a peak). Keyed tip updated. NOTE for testing: quicktest maps are temperate — verifying a modded biome needs a session with that biome mod + a matching tile (or the user's real save).

## JOB-SCAN SETTINGS TAB — BUILT 2026-07-23 (user-approved), awaiting in-game check
6th tab "Job scanning" (between Work and Combat; arrays [6]): presets Relaxed(1/900/2400/900)/Default(2/450/1200/600)/Eager(4/250/600/300)/Frantic(8/120/300/150) -> sliders jobProbeBudget/jobEmptyScanCooldown/jobMigrationCooldown (BetterWork keeps 3:4)/jobCacheTtl; per-flow checkboxes supplyConstruction/supplyBills/supplyMeals/fetchFromOtherLevels. All former consts now settings-driven properties (CrossLevelWork, LevelWorkSummary, CrossLevelDemand, CrossLevelHaul, both empty-scan cooldowns). **Blueprint.SpawnSetup postfix** (declared method) -> Notify_WorkChanged + CrossLevelDemand.Invalidate: fresh blueprints pull builders/materials instantly. Frame NOT patched (doesn't declare SpawnSetup). Future levers: bill-supply work-type giver, pressure scaling, overlay.

## 2026-07-23 TRANCHE 2 — BUILT, in-game check in progress
### Achtung! compat: prefix AchtungMod.Colonist.OrderTo — direct-linked-level pawns route via stairs + drafted Goto to formation slot on arrival; per-pawn dedup; forced-work out of scope.
### Meditation across levels (user bug): postfix JobGiver_Meditate.TryGiveJob — assigned MeditationSpot/throne elsewhere in column -> hop toward it; own-map assigned stays vanilla; 300t fail cooldown.
### Construction supply deadlock (user bug): WorkGiver_ABSupplyConstruction (CONSTRUCTION type, priorityInType 5, NonScan): builder ferries demanded materials down (constructionNeed sub-dict), then builds locally.

## ART TUNER (2026-07-23) — BUILT: "DEV: Adjust art" gizmo, live drawSize/offsets, Bake all -> Tools/ArtTuning.xml. Workflow: tune -> bake -> fold into defs.
## CLIMB/EMERGE ANIMATIONS + WIDE STAIRS (2026-07-23) — BUILT: AB_Climb/AB_Emerge procedural Root-node workers, thread-safe snapshots; ladders rung-bob; elevators excluded; climbAnimations toggle. Wide stairs 2x1 rotatable @ (2,1), climbFactor 0.8.
## TEXTURE / ROTATION REWORK (2026-07-22) — user stair art dropped, tuning pending. Riser host atlases. WATCH: no magenta stubs for foreign texPaths.
## MECH ESCORT FOLLOW — BUILT 2026-07-22, awaiting check.

## PRIORITY-AWARE CROSS-LEVEL WORK — USER-VERIFIED run #62. Perf caches now settings-driven (see jobs tab); event invalidation: designations + blueprints.
## MISC. ROBOTS COMPAT — USER-VERIFIED run #62.
## SETTINGS SUITE — SIX tabs (gen/view/work/jobs/combat/advanced), measured scrolls, presets, ABGuard panel, gen preview, Odyssey landmarks.
## Below-view rendering (USER-VERIFIED). COMPAT verified: sky biome inheritance; MO formations; BM variant mode.
## PARITY COMPLETE; pod transit + AA verified #39. 2026-07-21: stair routing, BC caverns, naturalistic peaks, camera lock.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; self-test suite; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell; cap corner fillers; DEV: Adjust art.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). Achtung! formation drags (soft, untested). Modded biomes: sky plateaus fully biome-driven (untested in modded biome). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-23: biome-driven plateau terrain + jobs tab + tranche 2 + animations + wide stairs + art tuner all BUILT (compile green); current test session predates the jobs tab + biome change — relaunch needed. Outstanding: art bake fold-in, brainstorm levers, mech escort test, settings preview pass, landmark UI check, Forced smoke-vent gen, bond/home, VCHE run, soak, publishing prep.
